title: The Alchemy Laboratory Incident
motive: Theft of a revolutionary patent for synthetic nerve tonic.

timeline.event: Dr. Sterling locks the laboratory doors to begin nocturnal distillation.
Night watchman notices smoke leaking under the heavy iron door.

dialogue_placeholders.suspect_001: We were testing non-lethal dosages earlier in the day.
dialogue_placeholders.suspect_007: I was archiving ancient herbals in the adjacent wing.
dialogue_placeholders.suspect_014: The ventilation system was inspected yesterday and worked perfectly.
dialogue_placeholders.suspect_017: Alistair stole my chemical formulas 20 years ago!
